keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words to match in the job title, e.g. "product manager", "react", "data engineer". A job matches if its title contains any of these. Leave empty to get every open role.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: Only keep jobs whose location contains this text, e.g. "New York", "London", "US". Leave empty for any location.

includeRemoteFeed.title: Include extra remote jobs feed
includeRemoteFeed.description: Also search a keyless public remote-jobs feed (Arbeitnow) for broader coverage beyond the curated companies.

extraCompanies.title: Extra companies (optional)
extraCompanies.description: Add your own company job boards as provider:token, one per line: greenhouse:airbnb, lever:spotify, ashby:ramp. These are searched alongside the built-in list.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many matching jobs.
